root_cause_findings.issue: Windows CDM temp path construction generated nested or overlong .tex paths
root_cause_findings.evidence: Initial CDM runs failed with FileNotFoundError under temp_gt/temp_pred; local single-sample reproductions isolated mixed slash handling and long filename prefixes.
root_cause_findings.fix: Sanitize CDM temp filenames to short gt/pred sample prefixes and pass absolute forward-slash TeX input/output paths.

root_cause_findings.issue: Windows CDM subprocess commands used POSIX shell quoting and /dev/null redirection
root_cause_findings.evidence: run_cmd([pdflatex --version]) passed only after switching pdflatex/magick calls to argv subprocess execution.
root_cause_findings.fix: Use argv-based subprocess calls for pdflatex and ImageMagick.

root_cause_findings.issue: Local TeX/ImageMagick toolchain lacked upgreek and Ghostscript resource discovery
root_cause_findings.evidence: TeX log reported missing upgreek.sty; ImageMagick reported gswin64c.exe and GS init/resource lookup failures.
root_cause_findings.fix: Installed TeX Live package was and injected bundled tlgs bin plus GS_LIB Resource/Init, Resource, lib, and kanji paths into CDM subprocess env.
